summary: babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small Babel plugin (~87-line AST transform in lib/index.js) but ships a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs" in package.json) that at npm install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory without hash or signature verification, then execFileSyncs the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling 727 KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array (WV8StW), a large numeric/char-code table (n7gIxM), and a custom-alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9), so endpoints, filesystem paths, credentials, and command strings are not recoverable from static inspection. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e, _0x19328d.YCZJE) and per-function string-lookup indirection wrapping every URL fragment, command name, and flag; it also probes /etc/os-release and `ldd --version` for Alpine/musl to select a matching Bun build. A Babel AST-transform plugin has no functional need for the Bun runtime; the runtime download is a code-execution vector used to run the obfuscated blob outside Node-oriented tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
